text:
Maya: Heads up 10 tenants had partial onboarding import failures overnight; 3 are in a renewal window next week. Need a short high-touch note + mitigation plan within 3h.

incident-bot: Incident onboard-imports: detected 2026-05-10T23:10Z, contained 2026-05-11T01:40Z.

Owen: Ill pull traces and confirm which tenants need manual retry.

Maya: DM list: Greenline (acct_gl), Northpath (acct_np), TempoHealth (acct_th) + 7 others. Failures ~23:05-23:30 UTC.

Priya: Proposed for the 3 high-risk: 20% one-time credit, 2 dedicated enablement hours, priority manual re-ingest, and a private office hour invite.

Sam: SE can run retries. Quick command: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/imports/retry -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"acct_gl"}'
```

Lina: Ops RCA: queue circuit-breaker tripped during S3 latency spike in GC window. We increased timeouts, drained backlog, and replayed messages. No data loss; some imports needed manual retry. Full RCA draft pending.

Maya: Draft outbound (short) for the three: apology, resolution timestamp, what were doing (manual re-ingest + verification), mitigation (20% credit + 2h enablement), invite to private office hour, and how to request immediate retry. Priya to send personalized emails; batch note for others tomorrow 08:00 UTC.

Priya: Ill send the three now and update Gainsight tags and renewal owners. Also capture feedback in tracker and schedule 7-day NPS follow-up.

Owen: Ill attach trace links for each tenant in the outreach note so customers can see the verification steps.

Maya: Plan set. Thanks everyone. (reactions: :white_check_mark:)
